findings.claim: This merge brings main's #6179 changelog item into the branch, and it describes the S2 guard wrongly. It says the walk ends 'when the commit the range ends at, whose first parent is that start, is not in the base either'. startsInBase (engine/review/app/chain.go:107-121) checks oldest instead: the oldest commit the range covers, which insideRange returns. In a range of more than one commit, the end commit's first parent is not the start, so the text matches the code only for one-commit ranges. Someone checking the delivery-gate safety rule from the changelog would read a weaker guard than the one the code applies. Main's review recorded this as -3 F1 and carried it to a cleanup batch (odd/tasks/review-chain-integration-base.md L5/L6). It is still open in the merged tree.
proof_refs: engine/review/app/chain.go:85-94 (oldest from insideRange passed to startsInBase)
